name: incline seated neutral-grip dumbbell front raise
description: A neutral-grip front raise performed with your back supported by an incline bench. It primarily trains the front delts.
instructions: Set an adjustable bench to an incline. Sit facing up with your back against the pad and both feet on the floor.
Let a dumbbell hang at each side with your palms facing in and your elbows slightly bent.
Raise both dumbbells forward together until your hands are about level with your shoulders, or stop sooner if needed for a comfortable range.
Keep your back against the pad, wrists straight and palms facing each other through the lift.
Lower the weights slowly to the starting position without letting the arms swing behind you.
